I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

The answer comes from Pree's own message in #central-team on 9 June 2026. She wrote that Pine Crossing's morning receiver was only seeing the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver had arrived at 7:10 the day before, and staff wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis said he would check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem with the store login.

I told Pree that nothing later in that channel says whether the problem was fixed. I only checked channels she belongs to and public files.
